## Day 1: Health Facilities in Somalia

Public health facilities per 100,000 people in Somalia. Using the WHO health facilities data for Somalia. only about 4 public health facilities are available for every 100,000 people.

```{r}
#| label: day01-setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(geosom)
library(patchwork)
library(ragg)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)

## Palette and theme ----
# WFP colours, softened (less saturated) for a flat, minimal look
tint   <- \(col, amount) colorRampPalette(c(col, "white"))(101)[round(amount * 100) + 1]
soften <- \(col, desat = 0.3, lighten = 0.12) {
  hsv <- rgb2hsv(col2rgb(col))
  tint(hsv(hsv[1], hsv[2] * (1 - desat), hsv[3]), lighten)
}

navy <- "#19486A"
pal <- list(
  ink   = navy,
  muted = tint(navy, 0.40),
  land  = tint(navy, 0.965),
  adm0  = tint(navy, 0.15),
  adm1  = tint(navy, 0.55),
  adm2  = tint(navy, 0.78),
  bar   = soften("#0A6EB4", desat = 0.35, lighten = 0.25)
)

facility_types <- tribble(
  ~type,                            ~colour,             ~size,
  "Hospital",                       soften("#C5192D"),   2.2,
  "Health centre",                  soften("#DDA63A"),   1.6,
  "Maternal & child health centre", soften("#0A6EB4"),   1.35,
  "Health post",                    soften("#3F7E44"),   0.95
)

font <- "Arial Narrow"

theme_day01 <- geosom_theme(base_size = 12, base_family = font) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position   = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, colour = pal$ink, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12.5, colour = pal$muted, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption  = element_text(size = 9, colour = pal$muted, lineheight = 1.15, hjust = 0),
    legend.position      = "top",
    legend.justification = c(0, 0.5),
    legend.title         = element_blank(),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 11.5, colour = pal$ink, margin = margin(r = 16)),
    legend.key.width     = unit(4, "mm"),
    legend.spacing.x     = unit(1, "mm"),
    legend.box.margin    = margin(0, 0, 6, -6),
    plot.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin          = margin(16, 18, 12, 18)
  )

## Data
admin0 <- get_admin_shape("admin0")
admin1 <- get_admin_shape("admin1")
admin2 <- get_admin_shape("admin2")

facilities_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/axmedmaxamuud/test_datasets/main/data/who_health_facilities_somalia.csv"

facilities <- read_csv(facilities_url, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    type = case_match(
      facility_type,
      c("Hospital", "District Hospital", "Regional Hospital") ~ "Hospital",
      "Health Centre"                  ~ "Health centre",
      "Maternal & Child Health Centre" ~ "Maternal & child health centre",
      "Health Post"                    ~ "Health post"
    ) |> factor(levels = facility_types$type)
  ) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_filter(admin0) |>
  st_join(select(admin1, admin1name), join = st_within)

```

```{r}
#| label: day01-map
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 9.375
#| fig-dpi: 150
#| dev: "ragg_png"
#| fig-alt: "Map of public health facilities in Somalia by type, with a bar chart of facilities per 100,000 people by region."

# Facilities per 100,000 people
coverage <- population_admin2_2026 %>%
  summarise(population = sum(population_total), .by = admin1_name) %>%
  rename(admin1name = admin1_name) %>%
  left_join(count(st_drop_geometry(facilities), admin1name, name = "facilities"),
            by = "admin1name") %>%
  mutate(
    facilities = replace_na(facilities, 0),
    per_100k   = facilities / population * 1e5
  )

national_rate <- sum(coverage$facilities) / sum(coverage$population) * 1e5

# Map
map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = admin0, fill = pal$land, colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = admin2, fill = NA, colour = pal$adm2, linewidth = 0.2, linetype = "22") +
  geom_sf(data = admin1, fill = NA, colour = pal$adm1, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = admin0, fill = NA, colour = pal$adm0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_sf(data = arrange(facilities, desc(type)),
          aes(colour = type, size = type), shape = 16) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = deframe(select(facility_types, type, colour))) +
  scale_size_manual(values = deframe(select(facility_types, type, size)), guide = "none") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(size = 2.6))) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(40.8, 54.2), ylim = c(-1.9, 12.2), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title    = "Health Facility Coverage in Somalia",
    subtitle = sprintf("%s public health facilities across Somalia with %.1f health facilities for every 100,000 people.",
                       format(nrow(facilities), big.mark = ","), national_rate),
    caption  = paste(
      "#30DayMapChallenge 2026 | Day 1: Points",
      "Data: ©WHO Somalia health facilities (HDX, 2023)",
      "github.com/axmedmaxamuud/geosom",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  theme_day01

# Chart: facilities per 100,000 people by region
chart <- ggplot(coverage, aes(per_100k, fct_reorder(admin1name, per_100k))) +
  geom_col(fill = pal$bar, width = 0.55) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", per_100k)),
            hjust = -0.2, size = 3, family = font, colour = pal$muted) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  labs(title = "Public health facilities\nper 100,000 people") +
  theme_void(base_family = font) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title  = element_text(size = 11.5, colour = pal$ink, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9.5, colour = pal$ink, hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 4))
  )

# produce final map
day01 <- map +
  inset_element(chart, left = 0.665, bottom = 0.02, right = 0.99, top = 0.47, align_to = "panel")

day01
```


## Day 2: Streets of Mogadishu

This map shows the street network of Mogadishu using OpenStreetMap data. some of the well know junctions of KM4, Ex control Afgooye and Balcad are marked.


```{r}
#| label: day02-setup
#| include: false

## Packages ----
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(geosom)
library(ragg)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)

## Palette ----
# WFP colours (WFP UI guide v1.0.0); lighter hues of them are allowed
wfp <- c(blue = "#0A6EB4", navy = "#19486A", aqua = "#26BDE2", yellow = "#F7B825",
         ochre = "#DDA63A", orange = "#FD6925")
shade <- \(col, amount, to = "white") colorRampPalette(c(col, to))(101)[round(amount * 100) + 1]

pal <- list(
  paper = shade(wfp[["navy"]], 0.94),   # page background, near white
  land  = wfp[["navy"]],                # the city
  sea   = wfp[["blue"]],                # Indian Ocean
  ring  = wfp[["navy"]],
  ink   = wfp[["navy"]],
  muted = shade(wfp[["navy"]], 0.45)
)

font <- "Arial Narrow"

## Road classes: colour and width by size ----
road_classes <- tribble(
  ~class,          ~osm,                                                        ~colour,                     ~width, ~alpha,
  "Main roads",    c("motorway", "trunk", "primary", "trunk_link", "primary_link"), wfp[["yellow"]],          1.5,    1,
  "Secondary",     c("secondary", "secondary_link"),                            shade(wfp[["yellow"]], 0.45), 0.9,    1,
  "Tertiary",      c("tertiary", "tertiary_link"),                              "white",                     0.55,   0.9,
  "Local streets", c("residential", "unclassified", "living_street", "service", "pedestrian"),
                                                                                "white",                     0.18,   0.45
)
lookup <- road_classes |> select(class, osm) |> unnest(osm)

## Data ----
# Mogadishu streets from OpenStreetMap, stored on GitHub.
# The file is downloaded once to a temporary file, then read with sf.
streets_url  <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/axmedmaxamuud/test_datasets/main/data/mogadishu_streets.gpkg"
streets_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".gpkg")
download.file(streets_url, streets_file, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)

## Geometry: a full-bleed 4:5 frame around central Mogadishu ----
crs_utm <- 32638                                   # UTM 38N, metres
centre  <- st_sfc(st_point(c(45.318, 2.046)), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(crs_utm)
cx <- st_coordinates(centre)[1]
cy <- st_coordinates(centre)[2]

# 18 km wide x 22.5 km tall (4:5), set a little north so the city fills the frame
xlim  <- cx + c(-9000, 9000)
ylim  <- cy + c(-12500, 10000)
frame <- st_bbox(c(xmin = xlim[1], ymin = ylim[1], xmax = xlim[2], ymax = ylim[2]), crs = crs_utm) |>
  st_as_sfc()

streets <- st_read(streets_file, quiet = TRUE) |>
  inner_join(lookup, by = c("highway" = "osm")) |>
  mutate(class = factor(class, levels = road_classes$class)) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  st_intersection(frame) |>
  arrange(desc(class))                             # main roads drawn last, on top

# geosom's coastline is drawn at country scale, so here it sits ~1 km out to sea.
# Refine it locally: land near the coast with no street nearby becomes sea.
somalia    <- get_admin_shape("admin0") |> st_transform(crs_utm) |> st_geometry() |> st_union()
land_raw   <- st_intersection(somalia, frame)
coastline  <- st_boundary(somalia) |> st_intersection(st_buffer(frame, 2000))    # the real coast only
coast_band <- st_buffer(coastline, 1500) |> st_intersection(land_raw)

# City footprint: 100 m grid cells that contain a street, smoothed (light on memory)
grid <- st_make_grid(st_buffer(frame, 500), cellsize = 100)
city <- grid[lengths(st_intersects(grid, streets)) > 0] |> st_union() |>
  st_buffer(250) |> st_buffer(-180) |> st_simplify(dTolerance = 40)

land <- st_difference(land_raw, st_difference(coast_band, city))
sea  <- st_difference(frame, land)

## Key junctions (coordinates provided by the author) ----
# nx / ny: label offset in metres; hjust: 0 = label to the right, 1 = to the left
junctions <- tribble(
  ~name,                 ~lat,         ~lon,          ~nx,   ~ny,   ~hjust,
  "KM4",                 2.031641448,  45.31066228,    350,  -450,  0,
  "Ex Control Afgooye",  2.045068388,  45.28266736,   -350,   450,  1,
  "Ex Control Balcad",   2.086576909,  45.36394565,    350,   350,  0
) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  st_transform(crs_utm) |>
  mutate(x = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 1], y = st_coordinates(geometry)[, 2])

## Title, legend and footnote positions (map units, metres) ----
spaced <- \(x) paste(strsplit(x, "")[[1]], collapse = " ")   # thin spaces between letters
W <- diff(xlim); H <- diff(ylim)

legend_items <- road_classes |>
  mutate(
    y  = ylim[1] + H * (0.20 - (row_number() - 1) * 0.032),
    x0 = xlim[1] + W * 0.70,
    x1 = xlim[1] + W * 0.76
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: day02-map
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
#| fig-width: 7.5
#| fig-height: 9.375
#| fig-dpi: 150
#| dev: "ragg_png"
#| fig-alt: "Map of Mogadishu's street network. Main roads are bold yellow, secondary roads pale yellow, tertiary roads white and local streets fine white lines. KM4, Ex Control Afgooye and Ex Control Balcad junctions are marked."

day02 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = sea,  fill = pal$sea,  colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = pal$land, colour = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = streets, aes(colour = class, linewidth = class, alpha = class), lineend = "round") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = deframe(select(road_classes, class, colour)), guide = "none") +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = deframe(select(road_classes, class, width)), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = deframe(select(road_classes, class, alpha)), guide = "none") +

  # key junctions: white dot with a navy ring, name on a navy tab
  geom_point(data = junctions, aes(x, y), shape = 21, size = 3.6,
             fill = "white", colour = pal$land, stroke = 1.4) +
  geom_label(data = junctions, aes(x + nx, y + ny, label = name, hjust = hjust),
             family = font, size = 4.1, colour = "white", fill = pal$land,
             label.size = 0, label.r = unit(0, "lines"), label.padding = unit(0.22, "lines")) +

  # title across the top, on a solid navy band
  annotate("rect", xmin = xlim[1], xmax = xlim[2], ymin = ylim[2] - H * 0.115, ymax = ylim[2],
           fill = pal$land) +
  annotate("text", x = cx, y = ylim[2] - H * 0.058, label = spaced("MOGADISHU"),
           family = font, fontface = "bold", size = 17, colour = "white") +

  # legend, bottom right over the sea: a road sample and its name
  annotate("segment", x = legend_items$x0, xend = legend_items$x1,
           y = legend_items$y, yend = legend_items$y,
           colour = legend_items$colour, linewidth = legend_items$width * 1.5,
           alpha = pmax(legend_items$alpha, 0.75), lineend = "round") +
  annotate("text", x = legend_items$x1 + W * 0.025, y = legend_items$y, label = legend_items$class,
           family = font, size = 4.2, colour = "white", hjust = 0) +

  # footnote, bottom left over the sea
  annotate("text", x = xlim[1] + W * 0.04, y = ylim[1] + H * 0.035,
           label = paste0("#30DayMapChallenge 2026  |  Day 2: Lines\n",
                          "Streets © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)\n",
                          "github.com/axmedmaxamuud/geosom"),
           family = font, size = 3, colour = shade(pal$sea, 0.55), lineheight = 1.15,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0) +

  coord_sf(crs = crs_utm, datum = NA, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = pal$sea, colour = NA),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

day02
```
